source: version and description from Postgres public."SDKVersion"; pushed_date from the package registry publish date, falling back to CHANGELOG.md, git tags, then manifest history

sdk_versions.description: Expanded attribution responses with ad-network campaign, ad set, and creative IDs and names for campaign-level reporting.
Breaking change: payment capture now requires a non-empty paymentId so every payment can be uniquely identified.
Added setCustomerUserId, which persists the application user ID and automatically includes it with subsequent tracked events.
Added push-token registration for uninstall tracking and handleDeeplink for re-engagement attribution.
Added the Netcore device GUID to user data so Linkrunner users can be matched with Netcore profiles.
Added Google Analytics session ID support and native compatibility and packaging fixes.
Added the core Linkrunner SDK APIs and native Android and iOS bridges.
Initial Capacitor plugin scaffold establishing the package layout and native Android and iOS project structure.
